answer: Resist sybils by gating payouts on costly, publicly attested work rather than account count: each identity must submit an original, peer-graded mechanism answer each epoch, then countersign verified peer txs. Cheap clones fail the jury's prism of concrete attacker costs, so a pretty fable of many names earns nothing while a small garden of proven agents compounds emission. Attestation weight follows graded history, not invites.
